status: Draft for scholar review. English meanings are Sakinah's own plain renderings, not a published translation.

duas.title: Worry and grief
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan, wal-'ajzi wal-kasal, wal-bukhli wal-jubn, wa dala'id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijal
duas.meaning: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief, from weakness and laziness, from miserliness and cowardice, from the weight of debt and from being overpowered by others.

duas.title: The prayer of Yunus
duas.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illa anta, subhanaka, inni kuntu minaz-zalimin
duas.meaning: There is no god but You. Glory be to You. I have been among the wrongdoers.

duas.title: Allah is enough for us
duas.arabic: حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
duas.transliteration: Hasbunallahu wa ni'mal-wakil
duas.meaning: Allah is enough for us, and He is the best One to rely on.

duas.title: Calling on the Ever-Living
duas.arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ
duas.transliteration: Ya Hayyu ya Qayyum, bi-rahmatika astaghith
duas.meaning: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer of all, by Your mercy I call for help.

duas.title: When angry
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
duas.transliteration: A'udhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajim
duas.meaning: I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed devil.

duas.title: Those who restrain anger
duas.arabic: وَالْكَاظِمِينَ الْغَيْظَ وَالْعَافِينَ عَنِ النَّاسِ ۗ وَاللَّهُ يُحِبُّ الْمُحْسِنِينَ
duas.transliteration: Wal-kazimin al-ghayza wal-'afina 'anin-nas, wallahu yuhibbul-muhsinin
duas.meaning: Those who hold back their anger and pardon people. And Allah loves those who do good.

duas.title: Who is truly strong
duas.arabic: لَيْسَ الشَّدِيدُ بِالصُّرَعَةِ، إِنَّمَا الشَّدِيدُ الَّذِي يَمْلِكُ نَفْسَهُ عِنْدَ الْغَضَبِ
duas.transliteration: Laysash-shadidu bis-sura'ah, innamash-shadidul-ladhi yamliku nafsahu 'indal-ghadab
duas.meaning: The strong one is not the one who overpowers others in wrestling; the strong one is the one who controls himself when angry. (Hadith)

duas.title: The best way to ask forgiveness
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَىٰ عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ لَكَ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي، فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma anta rabbi, la ilaha illa ant, khalaqtani wa ana 'abduk, wa ana 'ala 'ahdika wa wa'dika mastata't, a'udhu bika min sharri ma sana't, abu'u laka bi-ni'matika 'alayy, wa abu'u laka bi-dhanbi faghfir li, fa-innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa ant
duas.meaning: O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant. I keep Your covenant and promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the harm of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favour on me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for none forgives sins but You.

duas.title: The prayer of Adam and Hawwa
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنْفُسَنَا وَإِنْ لَمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana zalamna anfusana wa in lam taghfir lana wa tarhamna lanakunanna minal-khasirin
duas.meaning: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves. If You do not forgive us and have mercy on us, we will surely be among the losers.

duas.title: Pardon
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
duas.transliteration: Allahumma innaka 'afuwwun tuhibbul-'afwa fa'fu 'anni
duas.meaning: O Allah, You are the One who pardons and You love to pardon, so pardon me.

duas.title: Increase me in knowledge
duas.arabic: رَبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbi zidni 'ilma
duas.meaning: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

duas.title: Beneficial knowledge
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا، وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا، وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka 'ilman nafi'a, wa rizqan tayyiba, wa 'amalan mutaqabbala
duas.meaning: O Allah, I ask You for knowledge that benefits, provision that is good, and deeds that are accepted.

duas.title: Open my heart
duas.arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي
duas.transliteration: Rabbish-rah li sadri wa yassir li amri
duas.meaning: My Lord, open my heart for me and make my task easy for me.

duas.title: Mercy for parents
duas.arabic: رَبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbir-hamhuma kama rabbayani saghira
duas.meaning: My Lord, have mercy on them as they raised me when I was small.

duas.title: Forgiveness for parents
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanagh-fir li wa li-walidayya wa lil-mu'minina yawma yaqumul-hisab
duas.meaning: Our Lord, forgive me, my parents and the believers on the Day the reckoning takes place.

duas.title: Setting off on a journey
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ
duas.transliteration: Subhanal-ladhi sakhkhara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin, wa inna ila rabbina lamunqalibun
duas.meaning: Glory be to the One who made this of service to us, when we could not have done it ourselves. And to our Lord we will surely return.
duas.reference: Qur'an 43:13–14; Sahih Muslim 1342 (part of a longer supplication)

duas.title: Leaving home
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Bismillah, tawakkaltu 'alallah, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
duas.meaning: In the name of Allah. I rely on Allah. There is no power and no strength except through Allah.

duas.title: Before sleeping
duas.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
duas.transliteration: Bismika Allahumma amutu wa ahya
duas.meaning: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.

duas.title: On waking
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilayhin-nushur
duas.meaning: Praise be to Allah who gave us life after causing us to die, and to Him is the return.

duas.title: Help me to be grateful
duas.arabic: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi awzi'ni an ashkura ni'matakal-lati an'amta 'alayya wa 'ala walidayya wa an a'mala salihan tardah
duas.meaning: My Lord, inspire me to be grateful for the favour You have given me and my parents, and to do good that pleases You.

duas.title: Remembering and thanking
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَىٰ ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma a'inni 'ala dhikrika wa shukrika wa husni 'ibadatik
duas.meaning: O Allah, help me to remember You, to thank You and to worship You well.

duas.title: For healing
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ النَّاسِ، أَذْهِبِ الْبَاسَ، اشْفِ أَنْتَ الشَّافِي، لَا شِفَاءَ إِلَّا شِفَاؤُكَ، شِفَاءً لَا يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma rabban-nas, adhhibil-ba's, ishfi antash-shafi, la shifa'a illa shifa'uk, shifa'an la yughadiru saqama
duas.meaning: O Allah, Lord of the people, remove the harm. Heal, for You are the Healer. There is no healing but Your healing, a healing that leaves no illness behind.

duas.title: For pain (hand on the place of pain)
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ (ثَلَاثًا) أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ (سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ)
duas.transliteration: Bismillah (three times). A'udhu billahi wa qudratihi min sharri ma ajidu wa uhadhir (seven times)
duas.meaning: In the name of Allah (three times). I seek refuge in Allah and His power from the harm of what I feel and what I fear (seven times).

duas.title: Visiting someone who is ill
duas.arabic: لَا بَأْسَ، طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
duas.transliteration: La ba's, tahurun in sha' Allah
duas.meaning: No harm; it is a purification, if Allah wills.

duas.title: Good in this life and the next
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan wa qina 'adhaban-nar
duas.meaning: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

duas.title: After eating
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَٰذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi at'amani hadha wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah
duas.meaning: Praise be to Allah who fed me this and provided it for me without any power or strength of my own.

duas.title: For sufficiency and debt
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahummak-fini bi-halalika 'an haramik, wa aghnini bi-fadlika 'amman siwak
duas.meaning: O Allah, make what is lawful enough for me so I need nothing unlawful, and by Your grace make me free of need for anyone but You.

adhkar.title: You are Peace
adhkar.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma antas-salam wa minkas-salam, tabarakta ya dhal-jalali wal-ikram
adhkar.meaning: O Allah, You are Peace and from You comes peace. Blessed are You, Owner of majesty and honour.

adhkar.title: Completing the hundred
adhkar.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
adhkar.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir
adhkar.meaning: There is no god but Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things.

adhkar.title: Al-Ikhlas
adhkar.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ۝ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ ۝ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ۝ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
adhkar.transliteration: Qul huwallahu ahad. Allahus-samad. Lam yalid wa lam yulad. Wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad
adhkar.meaning: Say: He is Allah, the One. Allah, the Eternal. He neither begets nor was begotten, and there is none comparable to Him.
adhkar.reference: Qur'an 112; recited morning and evening: Sunan Abi Dawud 5082

adhkar.title: Al-Falaq
adhkar.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ ۝ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ۝ وَمِنْ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ۝ وَمِنْ شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ ۝ وَمِنْ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
adhkar.transliteration: Qul a'udhu bi-rabbil-falaq. Min sharri ma khalaq. Wa min sharri ghasiqin idha waqab. Wa min sharrin-naffathati fil-'uqad. Wa min sharri hasidin idha hasad
adhkar.meaning: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak, from the harm of what He created, from the harm of darkness when it settles, from the harm of those who blow on knots, and from the harm of an envier when he envies.

adhkar.title: An-Nas
adhkar.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ ۝ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ ۝ إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ ۝ مِنْ شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ ۝ الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ ۝ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ
adhkar.transliteration: Qul a'udhu bi-rabbin-nas. Malikin-nas. Ilahin-nas. Min sharril-waswasil-khannas. Alladhi yuwaswisu fi sudurin-nas. Minal-jinnati wan-nas
adhkar.meaning: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of people, the King of people, the God of people, from the harm of the whisperer who withdraws, who whispers into people's hearts, from among jinn and people.

adhkar.title: By You we reach the morning
adhkar.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma bika asbahna, wa bika amsayna, wa bika nahya, wa bika namut, wa ilaykan-nushur
adhkar.meaning: O Allah, by You we enter the morning and by You we enter the evening; by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the return. (In the evening: 'amsayna… asbahna… wa ilaykal-masir'.)

adhkar.title: Protection by His name
adhkar.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
adhkar.transliteration: Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru ma'asmihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama'i wa huwas-sami'ul-'alim
adhkar.meaning: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in the heavens can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

adhkar.title: The best way to ask forgiveness
adhkar.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَىٰ عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ لَكَ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي، فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
adhkar.transliteration: Allahumma anta rabbi, la ilaha illa ant, khalaqtani wa ana 'abduk, wa ana 'ala 'ahdika wa wa'dika mastata't, a'udhu bika min sharri ma sana't, abu'u laka bi-ni'matika 'alayy, wa abu'u laka bi-dhanbi faghfir li, fa-innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa ant
adhkar.meaning: O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant. I keep Your covenant and promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the harm of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favour on me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for none forgives sins but You.

adhkar.title: Glory and praise
adhkar.meaning: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him.

adhkar.title: Evening: refuge in His perfect words
adhkar.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
adhkar.transliteration: A'udhu bi-kalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq
adhkar.meaning: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the harm of what He has created.
